description: Specs of the main suite that must pass against the Go server, run with the e2e build (tests/e2e/README.md). Every M2 package adds its specs. An excluded test names its reason and the package of the M2 plan that unlocks it (package), or a capability of the build (requires). serial names the seed account whose stored settings a spec changes; with more than one worker those specs run afterwards on one worker. run-go-suite.js turns this file into Playwright invocations.

requires.passkeys: passkeys (D1, internal/auth/webauthn); in the build since the third wave
requires.e2e_hooks: the realtime shim maps the e2e_* hooks to the e2e. routes of the e2e build (D4); in the build since the third wave
